sections.h2: What Factors Affect the Price of Biweekly Cleaning in Clermont?
sections.html:
Two homes with identical bedroom counts can quote differently. Here are the variables that move the number up or down within the ranges above:

  • Square footage: The primary driver. A 1,500 sq ft 3-bedroom takes noticeably less time than a 2,000 sq ft 3-bedroom — even with the same room count.
  • Number of bathrooms: Bathrooms are the most labor-intensive room in any home. Each additional full bath adds meaningfully to the visit time and price, particularly tiled showers and double vanities common in newer Clermont construction.
  • Pets: Shedding pets create extra work — embedded hair on upholstered surfaces, dander on fans and baseboards, and odor management. Homes with active shedding dogs or cats should expect the higher end of the range for their home size.
  • Home condition at first visit: If the home has not been professionally cleaned recently, the initial biweekly visit is treated as a baseline deep clean and quoted separately at a higher rate.
  • Add-on services: Interior oven, inside refrigerator, interior window washing, and laundry folding are available as paid add-ons priced transparently in your quote.
  • Scheduling consistency: Recurring clients who keep a stable day and time receive the best rate. Frequent rescheduling or long gaps between visits may trigger a re-quote.

Braza Cleaning provides a firm, written price before any service begins. The quote you receive is the price you pay — no day-of surprises.

sections.h2: What Is Included in a Standard Biweekly Cleaning Visit?
sections.html:
Every Braza biweekly visit covers the full set of rooms your household uses day-to-day. Here is the complete standard scope:

  • Kitchen: Countertops sanitized, stovetop scrubbed, exterior of all appliances wiped down, sink scoured and shined, cabinet fronts spot-cleaned, floors swept and mopped
  • All bathrooms: Toilets disinfected inside and out, showers and tubs scrubbed (including tile and grout surfaces), sinks and vanities cleaned, mirrors polished streak-free, floors mopped
  • Bedrooms: All surfaces and nightstands dusted, mirrors cleaned, floors vacuumed and/or mopped; beds made on request
  • Living and dining areas: Shelves, surfaces, and entertainment centers dusted; ceiling fan blades wiped; floors vacuumed and mopped; glass surfaces and sliding door tracks cleaned
  • Throughout the home: Trash emptied in all rooms, light switches and door handles disinfected, baseboards spot-cleaned

Add-ons available upon request (included in your written quote): interior oven, inside refrigerator, interior windows, laundry folding, porch/lanai sweep, and garage sweeping. Braza brings all supplies and equipment — nothing required from you.

  • Time returned to you: The average Clermont homeowner spends 2–3 hours cleaning per week. Biweekly service returns over 100 hours per year.

faq: Is biweekly house cleaning worth it for a Clermont home?

For most Clermont households — working couples, families, active retirees — biweekly is the clear sweet spot. It keeps the home consistently clean, costs roughly half what weekly service costs per month, and eliminates weekend cleaning entirely. Homes with multiple heavily shedding pets or severe allergy concerns often prefer weekly service instead.
How long does a biweekly cleaning visit take in Clermont?

A 2-bedroom Clermont home takes approximately 1.5–2.5 hours with a Braza team. A 3-bedroom home typically takes 2–3 hours. The first visit runs longer because it is a baseline deep clean; subsequent biweekly visits are faster and more focused since the home stays maintained.
What is the difference between biweekly and semi-monthly cleaning?

Biweekly means every 14 days — 26 visits per year. Semi-monthly means twice per calendar month — 24 visits per year. Most clients use the terms interchangeably. Braza schedules recurring visits on a true 14-day cycle to keep intervals and pricing consistent year-round.
Do I need to be home during my biweekly cleaning in Clermont?

No. The majority of Braza's Clermont recurring clients provide a lock-box code, garage keypad, or spare key for access. All team members are background-checked and fully insured, and clients receive a pre-visit confirmation the day before every scheduled clean.
Can I add extra services to my biweekly visit?

Yes. Available add-ons include interior oven cleaning, inside refrigerator, interior window washing, laundry folding, porch/lanai sweeping, and more. Add-ons are priced transparently and included in your written quote before service starts — no surprises on the day of your clean.
What happens if I need to skip or reschedule a biweekly visit?

We ask for at least 48 hours' notice to avoid a rescheduling fee. Skipping an occasional visit will not affect your ongoing recurring rate. If two or more consecutive visits are skipped, the next clean may be treated as a reset visit and re-quoted based on current home condition.
Do Braza cleaners bring their own supplies and equipment?

Yes — all professional-grade cleaning products, microfiber cloths, and equipment are included in every visit. If you prefer a specific eco-friendly cleaner, an allergy-safe product, or want us to avoid a particular product on your floors or surfaces, just let us know and we will accommodate.
